message.content: {"summary":"You delivered a solid SSO reef-monitoring concept with clear purpose, users, and STK evidence. Your single-satellite rationale, 600 km SSO design, Vega E / Kourou selection, and Mt Pleasant access analysis show strong understanding. To improve, tighten orbital mechanics explanations, quantify swath vs reef width, and lift presentation to professional standard with proper figure labels and referencing.","next_steps":["In Orbit section, fix COE definitions: explicitly note ω and ν undefined for circular e=0 orbits, define argument of latitude u correctly, and justify RAAN separately from launch site longitude with azimuth explanation.","Add quantitative justification for 600 km altitude: calculate required sensor FOV / swath to cover 250 km reef width and link to your STK ground-track screenshots.","For report presentation, number and title all STK images (e.g., Image 1, Image 4), make formatting consistent, and replace bare URLs/Wikipedia in Bibliography with proper cited sources as required by the brief."],"criteria":{"C1":"You addressed all intro requirements well. Primary mission using fluid lensing + AI for reef monitoring, bleaching rationale with references, single-spacecraft simplicity, and users like CSIRO/BOM were clear in Introduction. To stay high in Accomplished, add more specific literature depth.","C2":"Strong design in Launch and Orbit: Vega E justification, inclination vs altitude plot, COE table, and Ground Control access report. Next level needs precise explanations - correct RAAN vs facility location, launch window vs azimuth, and add FOV swath calc to justify 600 km.","C3":"Your Conclusion effectively summarizes decisions from Launch, Orbit, Ground Control & Communications, and EOL drag sail, plus risks like Vega E availability. To strengthen, draw more explicit quantitative conclusions from your STK results.","C4":"You have clear structure with Executive Summary and readable writing. To reach Accomplished, fix inconsistent figure/table labels in Mission Design, add proper captions to STK views, and format Bibliography with in-text citations - avoid bare URLs and Wikipedia."}}
